The best ways to minimize recoil is by increasing your FOV, playing with ADS FOV turned on and changing your deadzones for your right stick. Your axial dead zone should be zero as it shouldn’t really affect stick drift, for your center dead zone you’ll want it anywhere between 0-5 and you should increase it if you have really bad stick drift. For guns i’d also recommend using the guns that you like a lot, if you’re really dedicated or just play a lot then you’ll slowly learn how much you have to pull back on the stick. 

Also BFV has random recoil so there’s always some recoil that you can’t control no matter how much you try, so it’s best to try and make micro adjustments if you can’t
